entries.name: DeepL API
entries.free_tier: Paid only for new signups: API Free plan retired mid-2026; API plans are Developer (from EUR 4.99/mo, 'test out the API for free'), Growth and Enterprise API; legacy Free keys (suffix :fx) use https://api-free.deepl.com
entries.desc_en: Translate and rephrase text or documents between 30+ languages via REST API, SDKs, or an official MCP server.
entries.notes: DeepL retired the API Free plan around July 2026; no more permanent free tier for new signups.

rate_limits.summary: Max request size 128 KiB, header size 16 KiB; throttle on HTTP 429

call.example: curl -X POST https://api.deepl.com/v2/translate -H "Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key $DEEPL_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text": ["Hello world!"], "target_lang": "DE"}'

entries.name: Google Cloud Translation
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2/IAM (GCP service account), or a simple API key for the Basic v2 edition

mcp.issue: entry lists no MCP server (mcp.url null)

entries.free_tier: free tier: 500,000 characters/month (permanent, not a trial)
entries.desc_en: Translate text/documents and detect language across 100+ languages via REST/gRPC API within Google Cloud.
entries.notes: Advanced (v3) edition supports glossaries/custom models; requires a GCP project with billing enabled even for free usage.

free_plan.quota: 500,000 characters NMT (applied as $10 credit every month)

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token) + x-goog-user-project (v3); the Basic v2 edition also accepts ?key=<API_KEY>

call.example: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" -H "x-goog-user-project: $PROJECT_ID" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" -d '{"sourceLanguageCode": "en", "targetLanguageCode": "pl", "contents": ["Bring me some coffee!"]}' https://translation.googleapis.com/v3/projects/$PROJECT_ID:translateText

unit_price.summary: NMT text translation: $20 per 1M characters after the first 500,000 characters/month (free, applied as $10 monthly credit)

entries.name: Lara Translate API
entries.auth_hint: An Access Key ID plus an Access Key Secret, created under 'API credentials' in the Lara Translate account dashboard after signing up for any plan, including Free; the secret cannot be recovered if lost.
entries.free_tier: Free: 10,000 API characters/month (shared by translation and language detection), no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Translate text, documents, images and audio with context, style, glossaries and translation memories, and detect the language of text.
entries.notes: Successor to ModernMT, which closed new sign-ups. Raw REST auth: POST /v2/auth/ signed with HMAC-SHA256 (Authorization: Lara:<base64-signature> plus X-Lara-Date) returns a JWT valid 10 minutes, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> and refreshed via POST /v2/auth/refresh; the SDKs do the signing. Hosted MCP uses OAuth by default and also accepts access keys; npm @translated/lara-mcp runs locally over stdio. Pay-as-you-go: EUR 20 per 1M characters (Pro), EUR 15 (Team).

free_plan.quota: 10,000 API characters (translation and language detection combined)

auth_scheme.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 signed key exchange for a JWT bearer token
auth_scheme.format: POST /v2/auth/ with {"id":"<access-key-id>"}, headers X-Lara-Date and Authorization: Lara:<base64 HMAC-SHA256 signature keyed with the secret>; then Authorization: Bearer <jwt>

call.operation: translate text (Bearer is a 10-minute JWT from POST /v2/auth/, signed with HMAC-SHA256 of the access key secret; see auth_scheme)
call.example: curl -X POST https://api.laratranslate.com/v2/translate/ -H "Authorization: Bearer $LARA_JWT" -H "X-Lara-Date: $(date -u '+%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT')" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"q":"Hello world","target":"pl-PL"}'

unit_price.summary: Pro: €20 per 1M characters; Team: €15 per 1M characters; free: 10,000 characters/month
